label: input token o at late original positions (t >= 5)
explanation: Fires only when the input token is the letter o during the original (pre-<DEL>) phase at position t >= 5. On dev every activation satisfies this (recall 1.0); it never fires on o at t <= 4, on any other token, at the delimiter, or in the copy phase. Magnitude grows with position: at t = 5 activations are weak (about 3.5% of mass, and about a third of o-at-t=5 steps stay inactive, which accounts for all of the false positives), while at t >= 6 it fires on every o at high magnitude (t >= 6 alone gives precision 1.0 and 96.5% of mass). The strongest activations are o as the final original token right before <DEL>. Its rate is barely affected by the surrounding tokens (prev_tok, first_tok, in_count).

issues: The core claims hold. On test, the predicate scores P=0.867, R=1.0, F1=0.929, mass recall 1.0, with 0 missed activations. On dev the feature never fires at t<=4, at the delimiter, in the copy phase, or on any token other than o. Firing occurs only at t=5..8, which is every original position >= 5 because L <= 9.

All 3688 test false positives are at t=5. Firing at t=5 is weak and partial: about 66% precision at every L from 6 to 9, and it carries about 3.5% of the mass. This is a consistent weak regime, not a hidden class. There is a mild dependence on what came before: precision is 0.84 when prev_tok is a digit and 0.56 when o was already seen or prev_tok is o. That is not strong enough to give a clean sub-predicate. t>=6 alone gives precision 1.0 but recall only 0.69 (test F1 0.817), so the t>=5 predicate is the better one.

One explanation claim is wrong: 'strongest activations when o is the last original token right before <DEL>' is a position confound. At fixed t, mass per step is the same for to_go==0 and to_go>0: about 4.2e-5 vs 4.2e-5 at t=6, and about 7.0e-5 vs 7.0e-5 at t=7. Magnitude depends on absolute position t, not on being last. The large to_go=0 share in the profile only appears because t=8 (the highest-magnitude position) is always the last original token when L=9.
'Magnitude grows with position' holds: mass per active step rises from t=5 to t=8.
